errors.text: The proposed compositions differ fundamentally from the AuCoCuNiPt target, so they cannot reconstruct the element-specific Au/Cu surface segregation and evaporation mechanism.

The N^2-versus-N ln N scaling argument is physically misleading: for condensed matter with predominantly finite-range interactions, the number of energetically relevant bonds scales approximately with N, not N^2.
The cited evidence concerns chemical ordering in Al-Cr-Co-Fe-Ni and does not establish nanoscale surface-driven instability, enhanced atomic diffusivity, or evaporation in quinary nanoparticles.
